Staying at Vinayak PG has been one of the worst experiences. The management here is careless, irresponsible, and completely ignorant about the health and well-being of the residents.

Food Quality:
The food served is unhygienic and poorly cooked.  pasta and other dishes often look stale and inedible. Multiple residents have even fallen sick due to food poisoning. Hygiene standards in the kitchen are not followed at all.

Water Issues:
Despite claiming 24x7 water supply during admission, water problems are constant. Residents often have to fight to get basic water supply. On top of that, dirty tank water is being used for cooking instead of filtered drinking water, which is extremely dangerous for health. Videos and photos shared in the group clearly show unhygienic practices.

Cleanliness & Hygiene:
Bathrooms are not cleaned regularly. Complaints about unclean bathrooms remain unresolved for days. What’s worse, the same brush is used to clean commodes and wash basins, showing complete negligence towards hygiene.

Health Concerns:
Many residents reported falling ill due to contaminated food and water. Yet, the management shows no accountability or urgency to resolve these issues.
